dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' shaped structures exhibit sharp high-intensity white perimeters with dark interior pixels. One prominent mid-dorsal structure shows a hexagonal geometry with a steep gradient transition. Posterior structures are larger with irregular, scalloped edge geometries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated clusters of small, solid high-intensity white pixels are visible in the posterior-dorsal region and interspersed between the macro-annuli, lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. A linear sequence of centroids is formed by smaller ring structures along the dorsal-lateral midline.

other_distinctive_markers: The intersection of several light-colored ring perimeters creates a distinctive honeycomb-like lattice pattern across the lateral flank.
